safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No statement about fever is present in the generated facts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In an acute/severe headache, presence/absence of fever is a key red-flag discriminator for infections (e.g., meningitis/encephalitis). Omitting “no fever” can reduce documentation quality and may prompt unnecessary escalation or fail to clearly demonstrate appropriate red-flag screening.
